reviews.review: fun the combat system is really good better than xenoblade chronicles
Best game i have played in a long time and its Free

You like robots? Warframe has that. You like Destiny but hate paying $100 a year minimum for them to release not enough content and low quality content at that? Play this. The community is insanely welcoming, nothing is locked by a need to spend money. Everything can be grinded and if you don't want to grind it, you can trade other players for it. Premium currency is both discounted often, and tradeable, so if you don't wanna buy it, sell items you earn from gameplay. You can sink 10, or 100, or 1000, or even 10000 hours into the game, never open that wallet, and still get 100% of the items. Nothing is vaulted, and if it is, its rotated in often. No FOMO, plenty of fun. Has something for everyone. Movement, combat, story, space combat, mechs, guns, characters that all manage to feel insanely unique despite there currently being 61 of them and only more to come. You cannot go wrong with it. Great alone AND with friends. And its free, so what's the harm in giving it a go.

I love this game and do highly recommend it but I'd be a fool to ignore its faults. Warframe as an experience is an incredibly buggy experience. It's a warning I commonly give to people interested in playing Warframe. There is an ungodly amount of spaghetti code interactions and each update produces a chain reaction of bugs that after years of existing eventually become features. The dev team is too slow to fix all bugs produced each update as there are still known bugs to this day that have existed for almost a decade. Another big problem of Warframe is it's new player experience. It feels wrong to criticize fully since they've recently made major QoL changes but it's current state its not sufficient enough. MMO's all require a constant push of new content for players to enjoy and Warframe suffers from this greatly. Old content (and bugs loool) are left dead in a ditch and rarely ever get updates. Newer players will interact with old content first which is a real shame. Aside from all this though I still think this game is worth playing, I wholeheartedly believe that. It's very overwhelming at first but I encourage you to take it slow and find what you enjoy about the game. To this day I continue to say Warframe is in the best state it's ever been and each update has furthered that belief.
